#!/bin/sh
set -u
proof=docs/proof/browser-audit-repairs-2026-10-15
export PW_PORT=37821 PW_SKIP_KEYLESS_WEBSERVER=1 PW_NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-onboarding-clock NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
PROBE_PATH="$proof/onboarding-clock-ambient-normal.json" node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config artifacts/onboarding-clock/verify.config.ts e2e/web-first-run-journey.spec.ts --retries=0 > "$proof/onboarding-clock-after-normal.txt" 2>&1
normal=$?
AMBIENT_FUTURE=1 PROBE_PATH="$proof/onboarding-clock-ambient-future.json" node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config artifacts/onboarding-clock/verify.config.ts e2e/web-first-run-journey.spec.ts --retries=0 > "$proof/onboarding-clock-after-future.txt" 2>&1
future=$?
node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js playwright.config.ts e2e/web-first-run-journey.spec.ts scripts/e2e/canonical-price-server.ts > "$proof/onboarding-clock-lint.txt" 2>&1
lint=$?
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run __tests__/playwrightProjects.test.ts --reporter=dot > "$proof/onboarding-clock-config-tests.txt" 2>&1
config_tests=$?
PW_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config artifacts/onboarding-clock/reuse.config.ts e2e/web-first-run-journey.spec.ts --grep "carries a located Soho" --retries=0 > "$proof/onboarding-clock-reuse.txt" 2>&1
reuse=$?
printf 'normal=%s future=%s lint=%s config=%s reuse=%s\n' "$normal" "$future" "$lint" "$config_tests" "$reuse"
[ "$normal" = 0 ] && [ "$future" = 0 ] && [ "$lint" = 0 ] && [ "$config_tests" = 0 ] && [ "$reuse" = 0 ]
